title: Rollout: five phases with proof
summary: Prove it → shop → open lanes → guided pipelines → scale — each phase has a proof gate.

blocks.title: Do not skip the proof column
blocks.body: Each phase unlocks the next only when something measurable is true. Skipping proof is how kits sit in a closet and assemblers wait on orders that never come.

items.title: Prove it
items.detail: 5–10 designs built and filmed. First stranger sales — not only friends and family.

items.title: Shop
items.detail: Listings live. Steady weekly orders at a price that covers labor and rings.

items.title: Open lanes
items.detail: Builders, designers, affiliates, then paid assemblers once badges and QC exist. Members earning on real sales.

items.title: Guided pipelines
items.detail: Members run content with playbooks. Founders edit less, coach more.

items.title: Scale
items.detail: Repeat bulk and workshop capacity without dropping QC or fair pay.

blocks.heading: Proof gates
rows: Bulk repeat with QC pass rate

blocks.heading: Weekly habit while rolling out
items: Ship or refuse: every open order gets a date or a no.
Review one risk from the Risks page.
Only then add a SKU or a lane.
